roles.Q1: Determinant: a cause of the variation
roles.Q2: Effect: an outcome of the variation
roles.TYPOLOGY: Defines or classifies, no cause or effect

direction_rule: Direction is the sign of change in the NAMED outcome quantity, never good or bad. '+' = the quantity named in 'outcome' rises. '-' = it falls. 'mixed' = it rises in one place or time and falls in another. 'none' = no change, or the authors did not assess it. Example: SOE losses grow -> outcome 'fiscal and financial burden', direction '+'. Privatization cuts the state deficit -> same outcome, direction '-'.
expected_rule: expected = true when the quote is a forecast, an expectation, a hypothetical ('may', 'likely', 'if... then'), a stated limit of the study, or a view the authors report without testing. Such a claim keeps its role (Q2 if it names an outcome) and gets expected = true. expected = false for measured or observed findings.
